result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: a vertically misaligned card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel and inconsistent styling of the favorite (heart) buttons in the 'Popular right now' list.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the 'Smash Bros Burgers' card sits about 28px lower than its neighbors. Its image top, time badge, title and delivery fee are all offset compared with 'Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola', so the row looks jagged.
issues.suggestion: Align all carousel items to the top (e.g., align-items: flex-start) and remove any extra margin or padding on the second card so images, badges and text share the same baselines.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons look inconsistent. On the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart has no background, while on the pizza card below it sits inside a dark translucent circle. This also lowers the ramen heart's contrast against busy imagery.
issues.suggestion: Use one heart button style across all restaurant cards, preferably with the translucent circular background, for consistent appearance and legibility.
